title: LprVehicleListMeta
description: User supplied and System generated attributes of the list. However it excludes the vehicle records

id.description: Unique system generated id for list

updateTimestamp.description: Timestamp when this list last updated

createdByUserId.description: User id of the creator of the vehicle list

vehicleCount.description: Number of vehicles in the list

ActorFilter.description: Specifies the attributes of an actor, useful for passing as a filter

id.description: The id of the thing that caused the event This can be camera or location ID. If not supplied for any entry in the array, it is taken to mean as the entire account.

type.description: Type of actor that caused the event.

LprVehicleListMetaUntagged.description: User supplied attributes of the list, that does not return the individual vehicle records, to be used during creation of list or patching of list

name.description: User supplied name for the list

notes.description: A verbose explanation of the vehicle list

ResourceFilter.description: List of actors against which filtering to happen (camera/location/account)

actors.description: List of the actors for which events are checked.
